evidence.title: Launch HN: Ardent (YC P26) – Postgres sandboxes in seconds with zero migration
evidence.excerpt: Hey HN! We’re Vikram and Evan from Ardent ( https: tryardent.com ). We re building database sandboxes for you and your coding agents. In the last two years coding agents have gotten dramatically more capable at handling complex engineering tasks. But without access to a realistic sandbox at the DB layer for testing, they ship garbage that can take down production databases. I spent over a year building an AI Data Engineer that failed for this exact reason. Evan spent the last 12 years in data…
